# #946 UF-B: WM1/WM2 save version recorded as unverified header declaration

**Changed.** `benchmark/writing/method.json` WM1 (original entry, about line 296) and WM2 (about line 376) keep `save_version: "unavailable"`. Each now also has a `header_declaration` object: value `20008000`, the source file and field in `benchmark/sources.json` (RSRC/LVSR first UInt32, byte_offset 92), `authority: declaration-only`, `status: unverified`, and the statement that no LabVIEW session confirmed it. No verified save version is claimed.

**WP1 shape.** I followed the WP1 pattern in `method.json` (`preservation.root_version: "20008000"`, `root_version_authority: "declaration-only"`, `native_save_version: "unverified"`, about line 595). WP1 has no separate object, so the WM1/WM2 `header_declaration` object is a new but equivalent structure.
